keyEvents.text: Goal! Lille 0, Bayern Munich 1. Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) header from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Tom Bischof with a cross following a corner.
First Half ends, Lille 0, Bayern Munich 1.
Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Lille 1, Bayern Munich 1. Ayase Ueda (Lille) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Nathan Ngoy with a through ball.
Own Goal by Aleksandar Pavlovic, Bayern Munich. Lille 2, Bayern Munich 1.
Substitution, Bayern Munich. Jamal Musiala replaces Tom Bischof.
Substitution, Bayern Munich. Luis Díaz replaces Josip Stanisic.
Substitution, Bayern Munich. Tim Binder replaces Hiroki Ito.
Substitution, Lille. Soriba Diaoune replaces Ethan Mbappé.
Substitution, Lille. Basar Önal replaces Ayase Ueda.
Substitution, Bayern Munich. Noah Codjo-Evora replaces Lennart Karl.
Substitution, Lille. Olivier Giroud replaces Hákon Haraldsson.
Substitution, Lille. Isaac Cossier replaces Benjamin André.
Substitution, Bayern Munich. Jonathan Tah replaces Kim Min-Jae.
Substitution, Lille. Romain Perraud replaces Calvin Verdonk.
